column1: # The KatWork build of EffectCraft: CLI and web with --no-default-features (the lock's features: -).
# plugins: the WebAssembly runtime and the external effect helpers
# plugins: the plug-in, helper and Plug-in Library commands and menu items, and the Library's
# https downloads (a feature of the engine, no crate)
# scripting: the ExtendScript runner (document expressions, effectcraft-expr, stay)
# scripting: the script commands and menu items (engine) and the Script Console (UI)
# model-download: the curl model downloads (a feature of the engine, no crate)
# self-update: the release checker and self-updater and its HTTPS client (native only: the web
# package does not resolve them on any target, so it has no rows here)
